idea-plugin.name: PowerShell Script Runner
idea-plugin.description: Run PowerShell scripts directly from the Project View context menu. Right-click any directory to execute pre-configured scripts with placeholder substitution ({{SelectedDir}}, {{ProjectDir}}, {{ModuleDir}}), and view output in the Run tool window. Works on Windows with built-in PowerShell 5.1.
idea-plugin.change-notes: 0.1.0: - First release. - Run pre-configured PowerShell scripts from the Project View context menu (right-click a directory). - Global script configuration shared across all projects (add/edit/delete/enable). - Placeholder substitution: {{SelectedDir}}, {{ProjectDir}}, {{ModuleDir}}. - Output displayed in the Run tool window with stop button and interactive stdin. - UTF-8 encoding for Chinese paths and output; temp .ps1 files auto-cleaned.
